newsitem.title: FRANCE: French minister seeks review of new youth radio.
newsitem.headline: French minister seeks review of new youth radio.

text.p: French Culture and Communication Minister Catherine Trautmann has asked that a youth station scheduled to be launched next week be reviewed in three months, one of her advisers said.
The youth station is due to be launched on June 17 by state-controlled Radio-France.
Trautmann has also asked the Conseil Superieur de l'Audiovisuel (CSA), the French broadcasting regulator, to carry out a study on the youth station, the adviser told Reuters on Thursday.
But she denied a report in Thursday's Le Monde newspaper that relations between Radio-France and the government over the planned launch had become frosty.
Financial daily La Tribune said on Thursday that Radio-France trade unions wanted the launch postponed, as they found the project shrouded in secrecy.
"There is no cooling of relations between the minister and the chairman of Radio-France on this project," the adviser said.
The name of the youth radio station has not yet been announced. DT/SLA
